# Model_Routing_Protocol

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanism for directing inference requests to the appropriate model based on task requirements, latency constraints, or model specialization. Enables efficient utilization of multiple model capabilities within in-network neuromorphic pipelines, optimizing performance and energy trade-offs.
